ITEM 1 | Bright green florets with dark green tips on a short pale green stem, clustered at top of plate, roughly 6 cm across, moist surface with slight sheen, firm and holding shape, lightly cooked | 45
ITEM 2 | Small loose floret pieces of bright green, sitting near center-top edge, about 1 cm each, firm, moist | 5
ITEM 3 | Triangular slice of thin-crust pizza with pale melted cheese, scattered red-orange pepperoni discs, golden browned crust edge, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, sitting at upper right, slightly oily sheen | 85
ITEM 4 | Shredded romaine-style lettuce leaves, pale to dark green with light creamy-white coating/dressing clinging to the leaves, wilted and glossy, forming a mound about 9 cm by 6 cm, moist and limp | 60
ITEM 5 | Creamy dressing/sauce sheen visible on lettuce surfaces, thin white coating over leaves, no separate pool | 8
ITEM 6 | Two pale cream-to-golden roasted chunks with browned edges, roughly 3 cm by 2 cm each, firm, slightly dry-looking surface, sitting in center-left of plate | 40
ITEM 7 | Dark brown to charred chunks with blackened, wrinkled surface and a few small dark crumbs, roughly 3 cm and 2 cm pieces, firm, slightly glossy, center-left of plate | 35
ITEM 8 | Small golden-brown cube with browned, crisp-looking edges, about 2 cm, sitting at lower center of plate next to dark chunks | 15
ITEM 9 | Small scattered crumbs and tiny dark specks of seed-like or charred bits on plate surface and off plate edge on left | 3
